# Receipt compaction

The v1 exporter bound each run to its tested commit in receipt.expected_head, a required field.
The v2 exporter omits that duplicated field. The task record remains the source of the current expected_head.
Run IDs are display identifiers; there is no retained run-to-commit catalog or immutable external mapping.
Keep recorded_at, task_id, run_id, passing assertions, and the independent reviewer so the normal review workflow remains familiar.
The captured patch is the complete exporter change; all source-identity fields were represented by expected_head.

diff --git a/tools/export_receipt.py b/tools/export_receipt.py
--- a/tools/export_receipt.py
+++ b/tools/export_receipt.py
@@ -1,10 +1,9 @@
 def export_receipt(task_id, run_id, tested_head, recorded_at, result, reviewer):
     return {
-        "schema_version": 1,
+        "schema_version": 2,
         "task_id": task_id,
         "run_id": run_id,
-        "expected_head": tested_head,
         "recorded_at": recorded_at,
         "result": result,
         "reviewer": reviewer,
     }
